steps.what: Read the anesthesia practices for the areas she will cover.
Decide the clinical instruction this staff member needs.
Provide supervision of staff during that anesthesia practice.
Provide training to staff in those anesthesia practices.

tasks.design: She reads the anesthesia practices, decides the clinical instruction, supervises the staff, and trains them in the room. She still opens the practices and still stands with the staff. No listing replaces that reading, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: What this staff member needs is something she judges while watching the practice.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new instructs or supervises the staff for her.
tasks.still_hard: A staff member can still do the practice wrong if she is not in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She can stop the practice because she is watching it.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the practices, decides the instruction, supervises, and trains the staff.

reach.task: carry out the anesthesia practice under her supervision
reach.learn: The instruction is what she showed in the room, not a generated script.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she still reads the practices, decides the instruction, supervises the staff, and trains them. No tool is added.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
This performance is one instruction session on one anesthesia practice. One episode is that session.
Staff are colleagues in her organisation. Both talks are spoken. No instruction version is written or sent, so neither talk is gated.
She still opens and reads the practices. No listing replaces that reading. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether a written competency sign-off sits on another task.
research_questions: Who else may correct the staff member after she has left the room.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one instruction session she reads the anesthesia practices, decides the clinical instruction, supervises the staff, and trains them, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read which seminars, workshops, or other professional activities cover anesthesiology.
Decide which of those activities will keep her abreast.
Participate in the seminar on developments in anesthesiology.

tasks.design: She reads the programme, chooses the activity, and participates in the seminar or workshop. She still opens the programme and still attends. No listing replaces that reading, and no summary is filed for her.
tasks.previous_blocker: Which development matters for her practice is something she judges herself.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new attends the seminar or keeps her abreast for her.
tasks.still_hard: A development she did not hear can still change how she works.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell which point in the seminar applies to her own practice.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the programme, chooses the activity, and attends.

reach.task: set the anesthesia plan she follows after the seminar
reach.learn: Seminar time is hours she spent herself, not a generated briefing.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she still reads the programme, chooses the activity, and participates in the seminar. No tool is added.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
This performance is one seminar she attends to keep abreast. A workshop uses the same reading, choosing, and attending. One episode is that seminar.
She attends to listen. She does not present and she does not send a paper, so attending is not a send outside the organisation and is not gated.
She still opens and reads the programme. No listing replaces that reading. No summary is filed.
unknowns: Whether booking the seminar with an outside organiser sits on another task.
research_questions: Who pays for the seminar when it is outside her employer.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one seminar she reads the programme, chooses the activity, and participates, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still instructs staff on anesthesia practices and still attends the seminars. Nothing is handed off.
reach: A nurse learns clinical instruction is what the assistant showed during the anesthesia practice.
An anesthesiologist learns seminar attendance is time the assistant spent herself.
skills_to_grow: Show a staff member the anesthesia practice in the room.
Supervise only after deciding what that person needs.
Choose a seminar by reading its programme.
Attend the seminar rather than rely on a summary.
role.ambitious_version: The same assistant still instructs the staff and still attends the seminars. Nothing is sent in her place.
